Regarding nasal polyposis, it is believed that the condition may have a recessive autosomal mode of inheritance. This pattern is similar to other conditions where there may be an increased risk of inheritance due to consanguinity or genetic mutations. In this case, research suggests that a common ancestor may have carried the mutation, leading to a recessive autosomal mode of inheritance in future generations.

It's essential to note that the specific patterns and risks associated with nasal polyposis can vary depending on individual circumstances and factors such as age at manifestation and course of the disease.
